The '''League of Legends World Championship 2025''' (also known as '''LoL Worlds 2025''' or just '''Worlds 2025''') is the crowning event of League of Legends esports for the year. The tournament includes 17 teams from all regions of the game in a months-long race for the Summoner's Cup, which was rebranded in this season thanks to a partnership between Riot Games and [https://www.volpinprops.com/ Volpin Props]. 

The Grand Finals played at the Dong'an Lake Sports Park Multifunctional Gymnasium in Chengdu, China. <ref>{{cite web |url=https://x.com/lolesports/status/1852339222906052826|title=The location of the 2025 @LeagueOfLegends World Final: Chengdu!|author=LoL Esports|date=2024-11-01}}</ref>

==Format==
* '''Qualification'''
** [[Mid-Season Invitational/2025|MSI]] champion qualifies into Worlds if they advance to their regional playoffs
** The top three teams besides MSI champion from each region (15 total) participate in Swiss Stage
** The 4th seed of MSI winning region (LCK) & runner-up region (LPL) start from Play-In

* '''Play-In''' - ''October 14<sup>th</sup>
** The 4th seed of the regions that obtained an additional slot from MSI compete in a single elimination match.
** Winner qualifies into Swiss Stage.
** The match is {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}.

* '''Swiss Stage''' - ''October 15<sup>th</sup> - 19<sup>th</sup>, 22<sup>nd</sup> - 25<sup>th</sup>''
** Sixteen teams play in a 5 round Swiss format. 
**{{Bgcolortext|up|Teams that reach 3 wins}} advance to Knockout Stage.
**{{Bgcolortext|down|Teams that reach 3 losses}} are eliminated.
** Elimination and advancement matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** All other matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}.
** Side Selection for Game 1:
**# Higher regional seed picks sides
**# If both teams have the same regional seed, the team drawn first picks sides

* '''Knockout Stage''' - ''October 28<sup>th</sup> - November 2<sup>nd</sup>, November 9<sup>th</sup>''
** Eight teams play in a single elimination bracket.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}.
** Side Selection for Game 1:
*** Quaterfinals:
***# Team with better match record picks sides
***# If both teams have the same match record, the team drawn first picks sides
*** Semifinals & Finals:
**** The right of side selection will be determined by coin flip

* '''Patch Information'''
** The tournament will be played on '''[[Patch 25.20]]'''.

===Worlds 2025 Draw Show===
*Swiss Stage Draw Show will be held after the completion of the Play-In and each round of play.
** ''Click links below to watch the Swiss Stage Draw Show videos: 
*** [https://youtu.be/VZnPBqbS-q0 Round 1] (Guest for the Draw: {{player|Ming|flag=cn}})
*** [https://youtu.be/DWPuaIoAdd0 Round 2] (Guest for the Draw: {{player|Jiejie|flag=cn}})
*** [https://youtu.be/Ca6TdUm50RM Round 3] (Guest for the Draw: {{player|Baolan|flag=cn}})
*** [https://youtu.be/zVbKtqnRd4Q Round 4] (Guest for the Draw: {{player|Crisp|flag=cn}})
*** [https://youtu.be/8TgA2j6O6lE Round 5] (Guest for the Draw: {{player|xiye|flag=cn}})
** <span class="mw-customtoggle-Swiss-Draw" style="border-bottom:1px dotted;">''Click here for detailed information about Swiss Stage Draw show''</span>
<div class="toccolours mw-collapsible mw-collapsed" id="mw-customcollapsible-Swiss-Draw" style="margin-top:10px;">
* Teams are split into 3 seed pools to ensure quality matchups.
** 16 teams are split into 3 pools:
*** '''Pool 1''' will consist of LCK1 (''GEN''), LPL1 (''BLG''), LCP1 (''CFO''), LEC1 (''G2''), and LTA1 (''FLY'').
*** '''Pool 2''' will consist of LCK2 (''HLE''), LPL2 (''AL''), LCP2 (''TSW''), LEC2 (''KOI''), LTA2 (''VKS''). and LCK3 (''KT'').
*** '''Pool 3''' will consist of LPL3 (''TES''), LCP3 (''PSG''), LEC3 (''FNC''), LTA3 (''100T''), and Play-In Stage winners (''T1'').
* Pool 1 teams will face Pool 3 teams, while Pool 2 teams will face Pool 2 teams in the first round.
* No team will play a team from their own region in the first round.
* Following the first round of play, there will be another draw for the second round to pair teams with the same record against one another.
* Each team will face an opponent only once throughout the Swiss Stage.
</div>
* Quarterfinal matchups will be decided by an on-stage draw following the final day of the Swiss Stage. 
** ''Click [https://youtu.be/JaHfXXuBdqs here] to watch the Knockout Stage Draw Show video (Guest for the Draw: {{player|Zz1tai|flag=cn}})''
** Each 3-0 team is placed on opposite sides of the bracket.
** In this draw, teams that advanced with a 3-0 record will be matched against teams that advanced with a 3-2 record.
** The remaining teams will then be matched against one another.
